questions.prompt: Which direction of data transfer usually costs money?

options.text: Inbound data transfer from the internet
Outbound data transfer to the internet and cross-Region transfer
No data transfer ever costs money
Only transfer within a single instance

questions.explanation: Inbound data transfer is generally free, while outbound to the internet and cross-Region (and some cross-AZ) transfer cost money — a common surprise on bills.

options.text: Always choosing the largest instance to be safe
Matching a resource's size to its actual usage to cut waste

questions.explanation: Right-sizing matches resources to real usage (guided by CloudWatch and Compute Optimizer). Oversized, under-utilized resources are the most common waste.

questions.prompt: Which are effective cost-optimization levers? Select all that apply.

options.text: Turn off idle non-production environments outside business hours
Use Savings Plans for steady load and Spot for interruptible work
Move cold data to cheaper S3 storage classes via lifecycle rules
Leave unattached EBS volumes and idle Elastic IPs in place

questions.explanation: Turning off idle resources, using the right purchasing options, and optimizing storage all save money. Unattached EBS volumes and idle Elastic IPs still bill — clean them up.

questions.prompt: Why should you commit to Savings Plans or Reserved Instances only after understanding your usage?

options.text: Commitments are free to cancel anytime
Commitments save money only for stable, predictable usage; committing too early risks locking in spend you can't use
There is no reason to wait

questions.explanation: Savings Plans/RIs discount steady usage in exchange for a 1- or 3-year commitment. If usage isn't yet stable, you risk paying for capacity that no longer fits.

questions.prompt: To attribute spend to specific teams or projects, you apply cost allocation ____ to your resources.
questions.explanation: Cost allocation tags (like team, env, or project) let you group and attribute spend in Cost Explorer and billing reports.

questions.prompt: Match each cost tool to what it does.

pairs.right: Alert when cost/usage crosses a threshold
Pool usage across accounts for volume discounts

questions.explanation: Cost Explorer analyzes and forecasts, Budgets alerts, Compute Optimizer recommends right-sizing, and consolidated billing (via Organizations) pools usage for discounts.
